__NOTOC__ {{recipesummary|category=Cookie recipes|servings=25|time=Prep: 15 minutes
Baking: 20 minutes|difficulty=2|image=[[Image:Single ANZAC biscuit.jpg|300px]] }}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Australia|Cuisine of Australia]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of New Zealand|Cuisine of New Zealand]] '''ANZAC biscuits''' have long had an association with the Australia/New Zealand Army Corps ([[w:Australian and New Zealand Army Corps|ANZAC]]) troops sent to Gallipoli during WWI. The biscuit appears to be a variant of the Scottish oat cake, said to be from the Scottish-influenced city of Dunedin. The recipe was created to ensure the biscuits would keep well during naval transportation to loved ones who were fighting abroad. The finished biscuits are quite chewy and crisp, and have a long shelf-life. ==Ingredients== * 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] plain (non-self raising) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] * 1 cup white or brown [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] * 2 cups rolled or instant [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]] * 1 cup desiccated [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] flakes * 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]], [[Cookbook:Corn Syrup|corn syrup]], or [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] * 225 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]] * 2 tablespoons of water ==Procedure== #Mix the flour, sugar, oats, and coconut in a bowl. #Melt the syrup and butter in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Add the baking soda and water to the syrup mix. #Mix the wet and dry ingredients, adding water if necessary. #Separate and roll the mixture into small balls, and flatten them on [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|oven trays]]. #[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 150°C (300°F) for about 20 minutes or until golden brown. ==Notes, tips, and variations== {{Wikipedia|Anzac biscuit}} * Using [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] instead of [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]] gives more colour and flavour. * You can replace coconut with more syrup and oats. * Don't omit the baking soda and water. They give the biscuits crispness and colour. * See [https://www.awm.gov.au/articles/encyclopedia/anzac/biscuit/recipe https://www.awm.gov.au/articles/encyclopedia/anzac/biscuit/recipe] for the official ANZAC recipe. == See also == * [[Cookbook:Anzac Biscuits II|Anzac Biscuits II]] [[Category:New Zealand recipes]] [[Category:Australian recipes]] [[Category:Recipes for cookies]] [[Category:Recipes using oat]] [[Category:Vegetarian recipes]] [[Category:Baking recipes]] [[Category:Recipes with metric units]] [[Category:Recipes with images]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert]] [[Category:Recipes using baking soda]] [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using coconut]] [[Category:Recipes using corn syrup]] [[Category:Recipes using all-purpose flour]] [[Category:Recipes using golden syrup]] [[Category:Recipes using honey]] [[Category:Recipes using margarine]] [[Category:Recipes using brown sugar]]
